methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Pressure on Richmond's young workforce suggests AI adoption is creating anxiety without corresponding deep skill development or distributed capability-building infrastructure to meet the moment.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-backed community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia represents distributed capability-building from the ground up, targeting historically underserved regions with hands-on skill development rather than platform dependency.

signals.title: Norfolk Southern deploys AI system to catch wheel defects before they break - The Business Journals
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk Southern's deployment of specialized AI for infrastructure monitoring demonstrates deep technical capability in Hampton Roads' industrial-maritime sector, but signals concentrated expertise rather than broad workforce adoption.

signals.title: AI could reshape thousands of jobs across DC, Maryland and Virginia - WJLA
signals.signal_reading: Regional job reshaping across DC-MD-VA suggests platform-delivered AI is creating broad but shallow adoption patterns where workers adapt to AI tools without necessarily developing deep technical fluency or control.

signals.title: Pentagon Expands Scale AI Deal to $500M and AI Defense Firm TurbineOne Moves HQ to Northern Virginia - Clearance Jobs
signals.signal_reading: Pentagon's $500M Scale AI expansion and TurbineOne HQ relocation to NoVA intensifies the concentration of elite defense AI capability in the region, deepening the metro-rural technical sophistication gap.
